profile.headline: Software Engineer III at SCI Solutions
profile.summary:
Full stack software engineer, working at DatStat on the platform team. The products we build directly affect millions of people around the country. They enable providers and patients to better navigate the complex world of healthcare through increased engagement, and by providing solutions for managing complex workflows and processes.

I've also worked for many years prior as a systems administrator, two of which were as a lead windows administrator for several departments at the University of Washington. Recently though, I've been moving more of my personal development stack to Linux.

As a hobby, there's always a small software project I'm working on to learn different technologies and keep pace with the industry's continually changing landscape.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full Stack SE. On a given work day, I can be working on anything from bug fixes, high-fidelity improvements, to implementing new features in our products.

Our stack runs on .NET core, C#, SQL Server, MongoDB, Angular, TypeScript and several other technologies.

positions.title: Systems Administrator / Developer
positions.locationName: Department of Physics, Astronomy, and the Institute for Nuclear Theory (INT)
positions.description:
- Provide helpdesk support for users
- Maintenance of the datacenter of 50+ servers (Purchase new servers, decommissioning, patching).
- Develop software to enhance the performance of faculty and staff workflows using C#, ASP.NET, DOS, PowerShell, etc.
- Maintenance of 11 computer labs.
- OSD using WDS and various 3rd party tools to streamline the process for automation and minimal human interaction (LTI)
- Maintain the systems infrastructure that forges the Windows and Linux environments into a coherent whole (LDAP, AD, SAMBA, User/Group definitions, permissions, etc.)
- Provide backup services (NetBackup, CrashPlanPro, tapes)
- Consult and collaborate on IT projects
- Support Instrument Shop CNC computing needs (CNC machines, CAD software, dedicated server)
- Troubleshooting various network issues
- Lecture recording equipment and usage support

positions.title: IT Operations Lead Tech / Lab Manager
positions.description:
- Supervise the daily IT operations and 8+ student IT specialists that serve as first-tier technical support.
- Proactively diagnose problems with computers, A/V equipment, and Crestron devices.
- Liaison with outside vendors and UW's internal IT groups to resolve issues.
- Prepare and deploy images to 120+ workstations used for classes and various analytic studies. Consistent communication with key groups and faculty members to maintain the necessary software and configurations for effective lab usage.
- Plan and support all technical needs for various events, often times involving very high-profile guests and speakers.
- Manage the internal resource scheduler application to book computer labs and other spaces that host technologies maintained by the group.
- Maintain the group's Sharepoint page - both the external informational listings, and the internal pages used by the group to manage equipment checkouts and other services.
- Manage and create/fix scripts for the various Mac OSX-based digital signage systems used throughout the buildings.
- LAN Administration tasks including Active Directory, computer and user account management, GPOs, etc.

positions.title: IT Support Specialist
positions.description: Troubleshoot and provide technical assistance to staff, faculty, and students on hardware/software issues related to computers and related technologies. Regular maintenance of workstations, computer labs, and other related equipment. Troubleshoot A/V problems in classrooms. Provide training for new employees.
